meta.title: Wakebound: a dark RPG inside Discord
meta.description: Clear portals alone or bring the whole server down on one boss. Free, set up in a minute, never asks for Administrator.
hero.system: A system window opens in front of you.
hero.what: A dark RPG inside Discord. Clear portals alone. Bring the whole server down on one boss.
hero.trust: Free. Set up in a minute. Never asks for Administrator.
run.1.title: Portals open on their own.
run.1.body: The board in your channel fills through the day, ranked E and up. Pick one and press Enter. You go in alone.
run.2.title: Enemies warn you.
run.2.body: A brute winds up a heavy blow and the game tells you before it lands. Press Defend in that turn and it blocks all of it.
run.2.system: ⚠️ Heavy blow incoming. Defend blocks all of it.
run.3.title: Deeper pays more.
run.3.body: After the first rooms, every cleared room asks the same question. Go deeper for bigger rewards, or leave with what you have.
run.4.title: The boss falls. The run pays out.
run.4.body: Beat the last room and the portal is cleared: XP, gold and Forge ore, and sometimes an item made for your class. Fall, and you lose what the run gave you.
classes.system: Choose your class. This cannot be changed later.
class.warrior.name: Warrior
class.warrior.role: Front line. You take the hits so the boss doesn't take your friends.
class.warrior.skillDesc: stuns the enemy, so its next blow never lands.
class.cleric.name: Cleric
class.cleric.role: Support. You keep yourself standing, and in raids you make everyone hit harder.
class.cleric.skillDesc: restores your HP mid-fight. It deals no damage.
class.mage.name: Mage
class.mage.role: High damage, thin robes. End the fight before it ends you.
class.rogue.name: Rogue
class.rogue.role: Nimble. You live on critical hits.
raid.title: One boss. The whole server. 24 hours.
raid.body: Nobody has to be online at the same time. Bring it down and everyone who helped is rewarded. Let it escape and nobody is.
lever.expose: The next {charges} attacks are critical hits.
world.title: A world that gets meaner the deeper you go.
world.ranks.title: From E to S
world.ranks.body: Your rank rises with your level. Higher ranks pay more and hit harder.
world.foes.title: Five kinds of foe
world.foes.body: Brutes wind up, casters build power, bosses enrage when hurt.
world.loot.title: Loot with effects
world.forge.title: The server Forge
world.forge.body: Everyone feeds it. Each level pays every hunter on every win.
world.scenes.title: Eight dark worlds
world.scenes.body: Crypts, caves, ruins, forests, volcanoes, ice, sewers and the void.
world.anytime.title: Play when you want
world.anytime.body: No login streaks, nothing to buy. Energy refills on its own.
final.title: The portal is open.
final.body: See who in your server wakes up first.
facts.1.title: Four permissions
facts.1.body: View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links, Read Message History. Never Administrator.
facts.2.title: One minute to set up
facts.2.body: Someone with Manage Server runs /config and picks the channel and language.
facts.3.title: Never pings
facts.3.body: Mentions are always off. It posts only where you tell it to.
facts.4.title: Your data, your call
facts.4.body: Reset or delete everything in /config. Removed bots lose their data after 30 days.

alt.shot.choice: After room 3 of 5 the bot offers two buttons: Go deeper, or Leave with the loot.
alt.shot.cleared: The Portal cleared message in Discord, listing the XP, gold and Forge ore the run paid out.
